versions.content: Service Name EthIf_WriteMmd Syntax Std_ReturnType EthIf_WriteMmd ( uint8 CtrlIdx, uint8 TrcvIdx, uint8 Mmd, uint16 RegIdx, uint16 RegVal ) Service ID [hex] 0xa2 Sync/Async Synchronous Reentrancy Reentrant for different CtrlIdx, non reentrant for same CtrlIdx. CtrlIdx Index of the controller. TrcvIdx Index of the transceiver on the SMI. Mmd MDIO Manageable Device. RegIdx Index of the transceiver register on the SMI. Parameters (in) RegVal Value to be written to the given address. Parameters (inout) None Parameters (out) None Return value Std_ReturnType E_OK : Service accepted E_NOT_OK : Service denied Description Writes a transceiver register using Clause 45 access or implements a Clause 45 access using Clause 22 operations. Available via EthIf.h
